newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Data show capex forecast to be met - Costello.
newsitem.headline: Data show capex forecast to be met - Costello.

text.p: Australian Treasurer Peter Costello said on Monday that capital expenditure data for the September quarter showed that the government's August budget forecast of 14 percent growth in business investment for the year to June 30, 1997 would be met.
Costello, asked about the prospect of another cut in interest rates, said the effects of past rate cuts should be allowed to work through the economy.

Asked whether business could benefit from another interest rate cut, Costello told reporters: "This (September quarter capital expenditure estimates) has been a very good result. Let's just let those interest rates work themselves through the economic system."
